facts.what: 发现紫色麂皮日记本不是自己的，犹豫是否偷看
facts.anchor: I’m reluctant to invade someone’s privacy without permission

facts.what: 误以为日记属 Finlay，觉得他藏起来说明不信任她
facts.anchor: he doesn’t trust me enough to leave it lying around

facts.what: 两次吼她「读它」，越来越响
facts.anchor: ‘Read it!’ a voice hollers loudly in my ear

facts.what: 他早前说她信的那套无意义、或许需要专业帮助
facts.anchor: he told me that none of what I believed made any sense

facts.what: 笔迹女性化、眼熟但想不起名字；首页主题圣诞
facts.anchor: too feminine with its curls and wisps, but there’s something familiar about it

facts.what: 读完呕吐、连读三遍；自觉写的是 Finlay，但不愿信
facts.anchor: There’s just no way Finlay would ever treat someone the way this book describes.

facts.what: 锁孔响，她把日记塞进睡裤腰藏好并挤出笑
facts.anchor: Tucking the journal behind my back and underneath my top

relations: Cassie 找到可疑日记；最初误判为 Finlay 所有
